summary: Sage separates assistive AI use (language, grammar, structure), which needs no disclosure, from generative AI use that affects content, methods, results or images, which must be disclosed and verified by authors. Reviewers may use AI for help writing and formatting reports but must not upload manuscripts or have AI generate their reviews. Editors must not use GenAI for editorial work such as decision letters or summaries of unpublished research.
